scope: Official API and reference evidence for implicit single-constructor injection into a Spring-managed bean. Actual configuration registration, injection identity, service execution and manually-created object control are separately verified by the compiled tests, not presumed from these documents.
version_scope: Four Spring API pages pinned to6.2.11 and JUnit Assertions pinned to5.12.2. The Spring autowired reference is the6.2 documentation branch; its explicit historical4.3 statement is retained with a content hash rather than falsely labeled a6.2.11-specific reference release.

claims.claim: Autowired constructor resolution considers dependencies that can be satisfied by matching beans in the Spring container.
claims.exact_excerpt: The constructor with the greatest number of dependencies that can be satisfied by matching beans in the Spring container will be chosen. If none of the candidates can be satisfied, then a primary/default constructor (if present) will be used. Si

claims.claim: The documented single-constructor annotation omission has been supported since Spring Framework4.3.
claims.exact_excerpt: As of Spring Framework 4.3, an @Autowired annotation on such a constructor is no longer necessary if the target bean defines only one constructor to begin with. However, if several constructors are available and there is no primary/default constructor, at least one of the constructors must be annotated with @Autowired in order to instruct the container which one to use.
